verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents automatic control mapping that identifies gaps and readiness status, but only for CMMC. It also documents per-framework control mapping with automated control testing and continuous daily monitoring of compliance status, which implies a passing/failing control view. Nothing documents a single readiness percentage per framework or a breakdown of what is left. Missing for 10: an explicit per-framework readiness percentage, a documented passing-vs-gaps-vs-remaining breakdown across all frameworks (readiness status is only shown for CMMC), and screenshots or independent hands-on corroboration of the readiness view.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a readiness view shows exactly how far I am from audit-ready per framework — passing controls, open gaps, and what's left, as one honest percentage

citations.quote: Map controls to CMMC requirements automatically to identify gaps and readiness status
Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Continuous daily monitoring of your compliance status with alerts for failing tests.
